```{r}
library(igraph)


# Read the list of  nodes and dates from the CSV file
nodes <- read.csv("hep-th-slacdates",
                  sep = "",
                  header=F,
                  colClasses = c("character", "character"))

names(nodes) <- c("id", "date")


# Read the list of edges from the CSV file
edges <- read.csv("hep-th-citations",sep = "", 
                  header=F,
                  colClasses = c("character", "character"))

names(edges) <- c("from", "to")

# Get unique node IDs from both columns of the edge list
node_ids <- unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))

# get actual nodes listed in edge list
nodes_used <- nodes[nodes$id %in% node_ids, ]

# make a directed graph with the nodes listed in the edge list
g_directed <- graph_from_data_frame(vertices = nodes_used, d = edges, directed = TRUE)




```
